classification: incompatible with the existing Buffer packet adapter

verification.tier: static binding and independently reviewed raw binary bytes
verification.registration: The inspected method is registered on the Msg class used by the actual Session getter and JavaScript wrapper.
verification.input: Both positional arguments use UTF-8 string conversion. Objects are coerced to strings; the second argument is not read as Buffer bytes.
verification.callbackAssociation: The local callback retains its invocation's deferred promise and resolves it with the normal response object.

sdkPolicy.selection: Only the exact platform, architecture, version and measured wrapper hash match this incompatibility.
sdkPolicy.action: Reject the existing Buffer adapter before packet-service acquisition or dispatch.
sdkPolicy.mergedForward: Preserve the upload phase error and upload/card not-dispatched progress.
sdkPolicy.retry: Do not retry, coerce bytes or guess an alternative encoding.

limitations: The full network response relay and callback arrival were not verified.
The carrier's reversible wire encoding is unknown; no hex, base64 or lossless protobuf interpretation is inferred.
This is an incompatibility finding, not a positive SSO or group-member-title capability.
Other native profiles retain their existing behavior and need their own evidence.
